mechanism: Spot-futures price-discovery / error-correction. A positive daily change in same-close OSE Mini minus Nikkei cash basis is hypothesized to indicate futures-led information that cash/futures direction continues into the next OSE interval.
literature_basis: Brenner, Subrahmanyam & Uno (1989): Nikkei spot and futures prices exhibit economically meaningful basis/mispricing behavior.
Frino & West (2003): Nikkei futures markets lead the underlying index in price discovery.
Qin (2019): Nikkei futures mispricing is affected by dividends, currency risk and transaction costs; raw basis levels therefore require conservative handling.

source.futures: Personally licensed 225Labo Nikkei 225 mini center-contract minute data
source.source_methodology: From 2011-02-14 onward 225Labo uses the most-active Large nearby contract month as the Mini center-contract continuous series.
source.cash: Nikkei 225 official daily close transported through FRED NIKKEI225

cash_close_alignment.through_2024_11_01: Use OSE Mini 5-minute bar OPEN stamped 15:00 JST against Nikkei official cash close.
cash_close_alignment.from_2024_11_05: Use OSE Mini 5-minute bar OPEN stamped 15:30 JST against Nikkei official cash close.
cash_close_alignment.rationale: TSE cash close moved from 15:00 to 15:30 on 2024-11-05; bar open at the cash-close timestamp avoids using later minutes.

roll_risk_exclusion.rationale: 225Labo center contract follows the most-active Large nearby contract, so continuous-series basis can jump around quarterly roll.
roll_risk_exclusion.sq_definition: Quarterly March/June/September/December second Friday; if non-business day, preceding JPX regular business day.
roll_risk_exclusion.excluded_window: 10 JPX regular business days before SQ through 2 JPX regular business days after SQ, inclusive.
roll_risk_exclusion.interval_rule: Signal day, previous basis day, entry day and exit day must all lie outside the excluded window.

execution.entry: Mini 5-minute bar OPEN exactly 5 minutes after cash-close timestamp (15:05 pre-2024-11-05; 15:35 thereafter).
execution.exit: Next eligible trading day's Mini 5-minute bar OPEN at that day's cash-close timestamp (15:00 pre-change; 15:30 thereafter).

costs.turnover: abs(position_t - previous_position); initial position starts from flat.

validation.fixed_subperiods: Four near-equal contiguous blocks frozen by observation count before outcome calculation.
all_required: 20-day moving-block bootstrap 95% lower mean daily net return > 0
at least 3 of 4 fixed chronological subperiods have positive primary net cumulative return
validation.recent_504_trading_days: report separately; not a rescue gate

true_jnu_confirmation.trigger: Only if OSE Mini Stage A passes every frozen gate.
true_jnu_confirmation.sample: 2023-07-24 onward from locally licensed 225Labo Micro center-contract minute data
true_jnu_confirmation.rule: Apply identical basis-change sign, roll exclusion, cash-close alignment, entry/exit timing and 1/2-tick costs with no retuning.
true_jnu_confirmation.promotion: Mini PASS alone is not a validated JNU directional module; exact Micro confirmation is mandatory.

forbidden: Add HAR/BOJ/FX/US-market filters to rescue a failure
Use basis level instead of delta-basis after outcome
next_action: Build source/alignment Data Gate and freeze the signal panel before reading any next-interval returns.
